name: sc-pick-queue-6p
description: 6-player strategy phase (pbd101 r1, TE, Naalu with Telepathic): Mentak queues Construction then Politics before its turn, restarts the queue and queues Politics then Construction; Nekro takes Politics, Naalu Leadership, Ral Nel Imperial, Titans Warfare; Mentak's queue picks Construction (Politics is taken); Mahact picks Diplomacy last, ending the phase: trade goods go on the unpicked Trade and Technology, Naalu's 0 token is handed out.
